datasets.name: SignerX/SignVerse-2M
languages: 55+ sign languages (aed, ase, asf, asq, bfi, ...)
datasets.description: Large-scale pose-native multilingual sign language dataset. Converts public sign language videos into unified DWPose-based representation (128 keypoints per frame: body, hands, face). Supports sign language generation, recognition, and translation research. Paper: arXiv:2605.01720.

datasets.name: intronhealth/NigBench-MAMAI-Speech-QA
datasets.description: Voices for Smart Care: Rural-first multilingual voice dataset for maternal health in Nigeria. Contains real-world maternal/reproductive health questions from women across Nigeria. 7 Nigerian languages: Hausa, Igbo, Nupe, Yoruba, Nigerian Pidgin, Fulfulde, Kanuri. Includes manual transcriptions, speaker metadata. Targets ASR and LLM development for low-resource African languages in healthcare.

datasets.name: latam-gpt/LatamGPT-Corpus-1.0
datasets.license: Custom (CENIA; commercial entities >$1B revenue need written authorization)
datasets.description: Latin American pretraining corpus by CENIA. Covers Spanish, Portuguese, English with focus on Latin American content. Gated access with attribution requirements. Includes technical traceability signals (statistical watermarks) for AI training detection. First major open corpus targeting Latin American languages.

datasets.name: g1moon/XIH-Bench
datasets.description: Multilingual instruction-hierarchy benchmark for AI safety. Evaluates instruction-following, prompt injection resistance, and cross-lingual safety across 6 languages. Tags: instruction-hierarchy, instruction-following, multilingual, cross-lingual, prompt-injection, ai-safety. Paper: arXiv:2607.23545.

datasets.name: MARUCIE/babel-bench
datasets.description: Ancient languages break every major LLM safety filter. Benchmark dataset + evaluator + defense catalog based on CC-BOS paper (ICLR 2026). Tests safety filter bypass via classical languages (Classical Chinese, Latin, Sanskrit) with 8-dimension annotations. 100% attack success rate on Claude-3.7, GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-flash, DeepSeek-Reasoner, Qwen3, Grok-3. Only open-source implementation of CC-BOS methodology.

datasets.name: saidutta69/odia-eval-benchmark
datasets.size: 125K rows, 34 source datasets, 487 subsets, 7 task types
datasets.description: Comprehensive Odia language evaluation benchmark. 125K rows covering QA, reasoning, knowledge, and other tasks. Aggregates 34 source datasets with both English and Odia prompts/references. First large-scale evaluation suite for Odia (Oriya) language LLM assessment.

datasets.name: ranjithraj/indic-multilingual-educational-glossary
datasets.description: Multilingual educational glossary covering English and multiple Indic languages including Assamese, Bengali, Bodo, Dogri. Useful for educational NLP applications and cross-lingual terminology alignment.

datasets.name: yagizgencer/emojinize-multilingual
datasets.description: Multilingual emoji understanding dataset with 108K rows across 15 language subsets. Each entry contains sentences with annotated emoji spans mapping text phrases to emoji sequences. Useful for multilingual text-to-emoji, emoji understanding, and cross-lingual semantic annotation tasks.

datasets.name: MAST Multilingual Queries 2026
datasets.description: Multilingual agentic search benchmark (MAST @ FIRE 2026). Evaluates whether multilingual search systems can answer complex questions posed in different languages. Builds on BrowseComp-Plus (ACL 2026).

datasets.name: Multilingual USAS Silver Labelled Wikipedia
datasets.description: Silver-labelled Wikipedia article text for training USAS semantic taggers and Multi-Word Expression identifiers. Covers 8 Wikipedia language sites, using Good/Featured articles from FineWiki.

datasets.name: ZamVoice (Zambia Multilingual ASR Dataset)
datasets.description: Continuously growing multilingual speech corpus for Zambian languages (Bemba, Nyanja, Tonga). Community-driven data collection for ASR research in low-resource African languages.

datasets.name: WorldSpeech
datasets.description: Large-scale 24 kHz multilingual speech corpus with 65k hours of aligned audio-transcript data across 76 languages. Collected from parliamentary proceedings, international broadcasts, and public-domain audiobooks. Fine-tuning ASR models achieves 63.5% relative WER reduction.

datasets.name: MaLA Bilingual Translation Corpus (EMMA-500)
datasets.description: Massively multilingual bilingual translation corpus covering 2,500+ language pairs for continual pre-training of LLMs to 500 languages. Used to develop EMMA-500 Llama 3 suite. Published at ACL Findings 2026.

datasets.name: Thiomi Dataset
datasets.description: Large-scale multimodal corpus for 10 African languages across 4 language families. Contains 601K+ approved sentence-level text annotations and 385K+ audio recordings from 100+ contributors. ASR baselines achieve 3.24% WER on Swahili.

datasets.name: SEAHateCheck
datasets.description: First functional test suite for hate speech detection in Southeast Asian languages (Indonesian, Tagalog, Thai, Vietnamese). Culturally relevant test cases validated by local experts. Builds on HateCheck framework.
datasets.size: Functional test suite (multiple test cases per function)

datasets.name: Chitrakshara
datasets.description: Large-scale multilingual multimodal dataset for 11 Indian languages from Common Crawl. Includes Chitrakshara-IL (193M images, 30B text tokens, 50M multilingual documents) and Chitrakshara-Cap (44M image-text pairs, 733M tokens).

datasets.name: INDIC-DIALECT
datasets.description: Human-curated parallel corpus of 13K sentence pairs spanning 11 dialects and 2 languages (Hindi and Odia). Multi-task benchmark for dialect classification, MCQ answering, and machine translation.

datasets.name: MMLU Localisation Project (EMT Network)
datasets.description: EU DGT-EMT collaboration to localise the MMLU dataset into 11 European languages. Creates a more inclusive benchmark for LLM evaluation with professional translation quality.
datasets.size: Full MMLU translated to 11 EU languages

datasets.name: Samasāmayik
datasets.description: Large-scale Hindi-Sanskrit parallel corpus with 92,196 sentences from diverse contemporary sources (spoken tutorials, children's magazines, radio conversations). Benchmarked with ByT5, NLLB, IndicTrans-v2.

datasets.name: ViDia2Std
datasets.description: First benchmark for cross-dialect comprehension in Vietnamese. 344 cloze-test items spanning 68 regional dialects from 18 provinces. Tests whether Vietnamese speakers understand other regional varieties.

datasets.name: NepTam
datasets.description: Code-mixed Nepali-English sentiment analysis dataset with ~11K sentences. Built from social media content, designed for NLP in Nepali-English code-mixed environments.

datasets.name: MathMist
datasets.description: Multilingual math reasoning benchmark covering 16K items across 16 languages. Evaluates mathematical reasoning capabilities of LLMs in multilingual settings.

datasets.name: MathNet
datasets.description: Real-world multimodal benchmark with 15K QA pairs in 5 languages spanning 34K images and 50K documents. Tests mathematical reasoning over real-world visual materials.

datasets.name: mAceReason-Math
datasets.description: Multilingual benchmark for mathematical reasoning. Evaluates LLMs' ability to reason about mathematical concepts across multiple languages.

datasets.name: Mdeval
datasets.description: Massively multilingual code debugging benchmark. Evaluates LLMs' ability to debug code in multiple programming languages. Published at ACL Findings 2026.

datasets.name: BHT25 (Brazilian Hate Twitter 2025)
datasets.description: Brazilian Portuguese Twitter hate speech detection dataset. Multilingual approach to hate speech detection in low-resource language settings.
datasets.size: Twitter dataset for hate speech detection

datasets.name: KannadaLit4NLP
datasets.description: Benchmark for Kannada language NLP tasks. Addresses the gap in evaluation resources for this low-resource Dravidian language.

datasets.name: VietMediSpecies 2026
datasets.description: Massive multilingual image dataset for Vietnamese medicinal plants. 310,647 images of 4,799 species from multiple kingdoms. Connects Vietnamese vernacular names to GBIF taxonomy with online Explorer.

datasets.name: MMMB (Massive Multilingual Multimodal Benchmark)
datasets.description: Multilingual multimodal benchmark with 6 languages, 15 categories, and 12,000 questions. Introduced with Parrot (multilingual visual instruction tuning). Evaluates multilingual capabilities of MLLMs.

datasets.name: michsethowusu/melo-tts-ghana-multilingual
datasets.description: Ghana multilingual TTS dataset based on Bible text with phonetic IPA transcriptions. Covers Ewe language with multiple speakers. Useful for low-resource African language TTS development.

datasets.name: Tonic/multilingual-EMIR-reporting
datasets.description: Multilingual European Market Infrastructure Regulation (EMIR) reporting dataset. Available in CSV, JSONL, and Parquet formats. Useful for financial compliance NLP in multiple EU languages.

datasets.name: masterofaudio2077/filtered-multilingual-pii
datasets.description: Filtered version of multilingual PII dataset with 945K rows across 6 languages. Contains annotated PII entities (ADDRESS, PHONE, EMAIL, etc.) with structured provenance tracking. Schema v1.1.0.

datasets.name: Souro/agentic-tooluse-adapted-multilingual
datasets.description: Multilingual agentic tool use dataset adapted for 23+ languages including many Indian languages (Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu). Passage-based QA with tool invocation patterns.

datasets.name: Souro/agentic-tooluse-synthetic-multilingual
datasets.description: Synthetic multilingual agentic tool use dataset with focus on Indian languages including rare ones (Bodo, Dogri, Sanskrit, Sindhi, Sinhala, Nepali). Generated via synthetic augmentation.

datasets.name: BUAIR/Uganda-Multilingual-QA
datasets.description: Uganda multilingual QA dataset covering agriculture topics (maize, coffee farming). Supports 5 languages including 4 Ugandan languages (Alur, Ateso, Runyankole, Luganda) plus English. Low-resource African language coverage.

datasets.name: mast-benchmark/multilingual-queries-2026
datasets.description: MAST Benchmark 2026 multilingual queries dataset for information retrieval evaluation. Covers 14+ languages with QA and text-retrieval tasks.

datasets.name: TerrorCoder/zimbabwe-public-service-dataset
datasets.description: Multilingual Zimbabwe public service dataset: 20K structured procedure records + 100K QA intent benchmark pairs across English, Shona, and Ndebele. Covers all 10 provinces, 60 districts, 32 municipalities. Developed for POTRAZ AI4I 2026 Challenge. Zero PII certified.

datasets.name: StereoTales
datasets.size: 650K+ generated stories, 79 socio-demographic attributes, 1500+ over-represented associations
datasets.description: Multilingual dataset and evaluation pipeline for studying social bias in open-ended LLM generation. 10 languages × 79 socio-demographic attributes, 650K+ stories from 23 LLMs annotated across 19 dimensions. Human harmfulness ratings (N=247). ACL 2026 era paper.

datasets.name: MBTP (Multilingual Bias with Thinking Processes)
datasets.description: Multilingual social bias benchmark incorporating human-generated pro- and anti-stereotype reasoning as thinking processes. 8 languages × 13 bias categories. Proposes few-shot meta-evaluation method. Published at ACL 2026 (San Diego). Authors: Kaneko, Bollegala, Baldwin.

datasets.name: SHADES (Stereotypes in LLMs Assessment)
datasets.description: Multilingual assessment of stereotypes in LLMs. 300+ culturally-specific stereotypes from 37 regions, translated across 16 languages. Paired with templates for unlimited evaluation. Covers culturally-specific biases absent from English-centric resources.

datasets.name: EspanStereo
datasets.size: Multiple Spanish-speaking countries across Europe and Latin America
datasets.description: Spanish-language stereotype dataset using human-LLM collaborative annotation framework. Covers multiple Spanish-speaking countries. Captures culturally specific biases absent from English-centric resources. Framework adaptable to other languages.

datasets.name: Fujitsu-FRE/MAPS
datasets.description: MAPS: A Multilingual Benchmark for Agent Performance and Security. Translates 4 agentic benchmarks (GAIA, SWE-Bench, MATH, Agent Security Benchmark) into 11 languages with 805 unique tasks and 9,660 total instances. First standardized evaluation framework for multilingual agentic AI.

datasets.name: GaoYao
datasets.description: Comprehensive benchmark with 182.3k samples, 26 languages and 51 nations/areas for evaluating multilingual and multicultural abilities of LLMs. Unified framework with 3 cultural layers (General Multilingual, Cross-cultural, Monocultural) and 9 cognitive sub-layers. ACL 2026 Long Paper.

datasets.name: Pluralis v0.1
datasets.description: Multimodal, multi-regional, and multilingual dataset for AI safety evaluation built from a culture-first perspective. 6,448 prompts across 6 Asia-Pacific countries (Bangladesh, India, Korea, Pakistan, Singapore, Taiwan) and 8 languages. Introduces multimodal evaluation where text+image synergistically trigger cultural/legal violations. Includes Judge-Pluralis evaluation framework.

datasets.name: WebFAQ 2.0
datasets.description: 198 million FAQ-based natural question-answer pairs across 108 languages. 14.3M bilingual aligned QA pairs (largest FAQ-based resource). Includes hard negatives dataset for dense retriever training (1.25M queries across 20 languages). Continuously updated via Open Web Index since late 2025.

datasets.name: iNLP-Lab/GlobeAudio
datasets.description: Multilingual and multicultural benchmark for naturalistic evaluation of Large Audio-Language Models. 5,637 multiple-choice questions across 6 typologically diverse languages, expertly crafted by native speakers grounded on naturally occurring audio. Tests higher-level auditory reasoning and culturally grounded interpretation.

datasets.name: vojewale/Cross-lingualIFEval
datasets.description: Cross-lingual instruction following evaluation dataset. Tests LLMs' ability to follow complex formatting instructions across languages including Arabic, with constraints on output format (JSON, Markdown, specific word counts, separators).

datasets.name: nvidia/Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v2
datasets.description: NVIDIA's agentic SFT training dataset v2. 6,834 downloads and 66 likes. Focused on agentic task completion and tool use for LLM training. While primarily English, the agentic capabilities are relevant for multilingual agent development.

datasets.name: fxmeng/UltraData-SFT-2605-no-think-8k-32k
datasets.description: UltraData SFT no-think variant with 8K-32K context window. Derived from openbmb/UltraData-SFT-2605 (14K+ downloads, 378 likes). Tags include 'multilingual'. Designed for non-reasoning (direct response) training mode, complementing the thinking-mode data in the original UltraData.

datasets.name: fxmeng/UltraData-SFT-2605-no-think-32k-200k
datasets.description: UltraData SFT no-think variant with extended 32K-200K context window. Tags include 'multilingual'. Long-context non-reasoning SFT data for training models to handle extended inputs without chain-of-thought.

datasets.name: BENI Global 10
datasets.description: First multilingual economic news narrative corpus for the Global South. Covers multiple languages including Bangla, Hindi, and other South Asian languages. Focuses on economic narratives and financial discourse in underrepresented regions.

datasets.name: crosslingual-rule-following/rule-following-eval
datasets.description: Cross-lingual rule following evaluation dataset. Tests LLMs' ability to follow explicit rules across languages including Korean, Spanish, and English. Includes regex-based and LLM-judge evaluation criteria for multilingual rule compliance.

datasets.name: crosslingual-rule-following/model-inference-responses
datasets.description: Model inference responses dataset for cross-lingual rule following evaluation. Contains LLM outputs across multiple languages for analyzing cross-lingual instruction following capabilities.

datasets.name: sripad17/multilingual-safety-probe-test
datasets.description: Multilingual safety probe test dataset for evaluating LLM safety across English, Russian, Serbian, and Telugu. Tests model responses to potentially unsafe inputs in diverse linguistic contexts.

datasets.name: multilingual-safety-anon/lsr-anchoring-phase2-results
datasets.description: Language-specific safety anchoring results for African and low-resource languages (Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, Swahili, Arabic). Phase 2 evaluation of safety alignment approaches in underrepresented languages.

datasets.name: issdandavis/UltraData-Math
datasets.description: UltraData Math derivative dataset (en, zh). 368 downloads. Adapted from the popular openbmb/UltraData-Math (23K downloads, 331 likes). Mathematical reasoning training data for bilingual English-Chinese LLM development.

datasets.name: alrazz-n/HPLT3-PerRef
datasets.description: HPLT 3.0 Personal Reference dataset. Derivative of the HPLT 3.0 corpus (30T tokens, ~200 languages) curated for personalized reference and evaluation purposes.

datasets.name: nvidia/Nemotron-RL-Ultra-Training-Blends
datasets.description: NVIDIA's RL training blends dataset for Nemotron models. 1,335 downloads and 15 likes. Reinforcement learning training data mixing multiple domains. Primarily English but relevant for RLHF pipeline methodology transfer to multilingual settings.

datasets.name: pinkachu/harmless_multilingual
datasets.description: Multilingual harmless instructions dataset. Contains diverse harmless prompts in Spanish and other languages for safety alignment training (paired with harmful_multilingual for contrastive learning).

datasets.name: uludagur/crosslingual-clinical-rag-study
datasets.description: Cross-lingual clinical RAG study dataset. Turkish-English medical question answering dataset for evaluating cross-lingual retrieval-augmented generation in clinical domains.

datasets.name: bcv-commons/cross-lingual-span-profile
datasets.description: Cross-lingual span profiling dataset. 94 downloads. Designed for evaluating cross-lingual named entity recognition and span extraction capabilities.

datasets.name: 15juneee/agriculture-advisor-adapted-multilingual-v1
datasets.description: Agriculture advisor adapted for multilingual contexts. English-language agricultural QA dataset adapted for multilingual instruction following in the agriculture domain.

datasets.name: lingamvamshikrishnareddy/ramanv-indic-multilingual
datasets.description: Indic multilingual dataset with 427 downloads. Covers multiple Indian languages for NLP tasks.

datasets.name: Tonic/multilingual-EMIR-reporting-csv
datasets.description: Multilingual EMIR (European Market Infrastructure Regulation) reporting dataset in CSV format. Financial regulatory data across multiple European languages.

datasets.name: CultSportQA
datasets.description: Multilingual, multicultural benchmark assessing LMs' understanding of traditional sports across 60 countries and 6 continents. 33,000 multiple-choice questions across text and image modalities with 4 cultural categories. Tests zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting.

datasets.name: Multilingual News Ukraine Dataset
datasets.description: Multilingual news dataset about Ukraine (2022-2025). Large-scale longitudinal news corpus covering multiple languages, published in Scientific Data (Nature). Useful for pretraining and evaluation on news domain data.

version_updates.name: ucrelnlp/Multilingual-USAS-Labelled-Silver-Wikipedia
version_updates.note: Updated since round 12 discovery; still actively maintained

version_updates.name: SWE-bench/SWE-bench_Multilingual
version_updates.note: Continued updates; highest-download multilingual code benchmark in our tracking

version_updates.name: fevziegeyurtsevenler/multilingual-prompt-injection
version_updates.note: Companion to multilingual-jailbreak (already in baseline); structured prompt injection dataset with OWASP/AML threat taxonomy tagging across multiple languages

version_updates.name: HPLT 3.0
version_updates.description: HPLT 3.0 paper published at LREC-COLING 2026. Very large-scale multilingual resources for LLMs and MT, including mono/bilingual data, evaluation, and pre-trained models.

papers.name: paper PolyWorkBench: Benchmarking Multilingual Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.description: First benchmark for multilingual long-horizon LLM agent workflows. 67 tasks across 5 domains (commerce, knowledge work, legal, localization, manufacturing). SOTA agents show significant degradation in multilingual settings. Hybrid evaluation: structural + executable + LLM-based.

papers.name: paper CC-BOS: Classical Language Safety Bypass (ICLR 2026)
papers.description: Proves that LLM safety alignment (RLHF/SFT) only covers modern languages. Models understand classical languages (pre-trained on historical corpora) but safety layers don't fire. 100% attack success on all 6 frontier models via Classical Chinese, Latin, Sanskrit. Open-source implementation: babel-bench (see new datasets).

papers.name: paper Mix, MinHash, and Match: Cross-Source Agreement for Multilingual Pretraining Datasets
papers.description: Cross-source agreement as free, model-free quality filter for multilingual pretraining data. Applied to Arabic, Turkish, Hindi, Thai, Italian, Indonesian, Korean, Japanese, Vietnamese. Produces corpora matching/exceeding best single-source baselines. Collection: huggingface.co/collections/AdaMLLab/mixminmatch (multiple datasets, 535M-974M tokens each).
papers.dataset_name: AdaMLLab/MixMinMatch collection (AraMix, TurMix, HinMix, ThaMix, ItaMix, IndMix, KorMix, JpnMix, VieMix)

papers.title: Building a European Multilingual Evaluation Dataset: The MMLU Localisation Project within the EMT Network
papers.summary: Collaboration between EU DGT and European Master's in Translation to localise MMLU into 11 European languages. Creates inclusive LLM evaluation benchmark with professional translation quality.
papers.relevance: 直接关联：多语言评估基准本地化方法论

papers.title: Data-Centric Continual Pre-training for 500+ Languages: A New Bilingual Translation Corpus and Multilingual Models (MaLA/EMMA-500)
papers.summary: Constructs MaLA bilingual translation corpus (2,507 language pairs) and develops EMMA-500 Llama 3 suite. Demonstrates bilingual data enhances language transfer, especially for low-resource languages.
papers.relevance: 核心参考：500语言大规模平行语料构建方法论

papers.title: WorldSpeech: A Multilingual Speech Corpus from Around the World
papers.summary: 76-language 65K-hour aligned speech corpus from parliamentary, broadcast, and audiobook sources. Achieves 63.5% relative WER reduction when fine-tuning ASR models.
papers.relevance: 重要参考：大规模多语言语音语料构建方法

papers.title: The Thiomi Dataset: A Large-Scale Multimodal Corpus for Low-Resource African Languages
papers.summary: 10 African languages across 4 families with 601K+ text annotations and 385K+ audio recordings. Community-driven platform with 100+ contributors. ASR achieves 3.24% WER on Swahili.
papers.relevance: 重要参考：非洲语言多模态数据集社区构建模式

papers.title: Data-Centric Continual Pre-training for 500+ Languages (MaLA bilingual corpus)
papers.summary: Updated version of the MaLA corpus paper. Studies impact of bilingual translation data for massively multilingual language adaptation. Constructs corpus of 2,500+ language pairs.
papers.relevance: 核心参考：大规模多语言持续预训练数据策略

papers.title: The State and Fate of Multilingual, Contextual Evaluation in the NLP World
papers.summary: Comprehensive survey of 51 recent multilingual benchmarks spanning 242 datasets and 219 unique languages. Analyzes evaluation gaps and methodologies.
papers.relevance: 元参考：多语言评估基准全景综述
